# 模拟卷 B：答案与评分要点

> 完成试卷后再打开。本卷存在合理等价答案；不要机械匹配范文。

## 听力稿（原创训练新闻）

### 城市绿地项目

Local officials have approved a plan to turn an empty factory site into a public park. Construction is expected to begin in March, following a public consultation. The project will include walking paths and a small area for outdoor classes. Environmental researchers say that urban green spaces can reduce summer temperatures and provide opportunities for exercise. However, they warn that these benefits depend on careful maintenance. The council has promised to publish the full budget before work begins.

### 研究技能工作坊

A university writing centre is introducing a series of workshops for new postgraduate students. The sessions will focus on summarising research and acknowledging sources. In a recent survey, students identified paraphrasing as their greatest difficulty. Tutors will therefore teach them to record the central idea before changing sentence structure. They will also explain why replacing a few words is not enough to avoid plagiarism. Participants will complete a short writing task, and receive individual feedback within one week.

## 二、句子纠错

### B-C1

After the participants had read the instructions, they began the task.

原句只有从句，是片段；补合理主句。

### B-C2

The method was simple, and it produced reliable results.

两个独立分句应使用正确标点和连接。

### B-C3

One of the most important findings is discussed below.

one 是主语中心词。

### B-C4

Students need to read carefully, take notes, and revise regularly.

to 后并列动词原形 read/take/revise。

### B-C5

Although the sample was small, the study was useful.

despite 后接名词或动名词；although 后接完整从句。

### B-C6

The evidence supports the claim; therefore, we accept it.

therefore 是连接副词，前面的独立分句需分号或句号。

### B-C7

The report gives advice about time management.

advice 不可数；可说 a piece of advice。

### B-C8

The results of the experiment show a clear pattern.

中心词 results 是复数。

### B-C9

To understand the passage, Mei used a dictionary.

目的状语的逻辑主语是 Mei。

### B-C10

The article is clear and logical, and it provides useful examples.

将两个形容词并列，再连接完整分句；有其他正确改法。

## 三、段落改写与续写

### B-P1

Online courses offer flexibility in both time and place. Students who work during the day can watch lectures in the evening, while those who live far from the campus can study at home. In addition, recorded lessons allow learners to pause a lecture and review difficult points at their own pace. These features make online courses particularly useful for people who cannot attend regular classroom sessions.

删除 old buildings 句（2分）；主题统一（2分）；组织与衔接（2分）；语言（2分）。

### B-P2

Universities should teach new students how to evaluate online information. First, search results often mix carefully researched articles with unsupported opinions, so students need to check who wrote a source and what evidence it provides. Second, even accurate information can become outdated. Students should therefore examine publication dates and compare several reliable sources. These habits can help them build stronger arguments and avoid repeating misleading claims in their academic work.

两个有效理由各2分；逻辑与结句2分；语言2分。

## 四、Paraphrase

### B-R1

Identifying the central point of a lengthy article is difficult for many students.

动名词主语转换；保留 many。 原意1分、改写幅度1分、语言1分。

### B-R2

To respond to students' needs, the library remained open for longer.

目的结构前置，避免改变时态。 原意1分、改写幅度1分、语言1分。

### B-R3

Ideas taken from other authors require acknowledgement, even if researchers rephrase them.

必须保留引用义务；换词不能免除引用。 原意1分、改写幅度1分、语言1分。

## 五、Summary

### B-S1

A writing centre found that guided peer review helped students improve organisation and recognise problems in their own drafts. However, peers sometimes gave inaccurate grammar advice. Tutors therefore recommended teacher support and examples of constructive feedback to make future peer-review activities more effective.

主旨3分；关键方法/结果3分；限制或条件2分；简洁与语言2分。例文可有其他表达。

## 六、短文写作

### B-E1

Many postgraduate students find academic writing in English difficult. Two common causes are limited exposure to academic texts and insufficient practice in organising an argument. These difficulties can affect both communication and study time.

Students who rarely read academic English may know individual words but remain unfamiliar with common word combinations. As a result, they may translate directly from their first language and produce unclear sentences. For example, choosing a dictionary synonym without checking its context can change the meaning of a claim.

A second cause is the belief that good writing depends mainly on correct grammar. Students who focus only on sentence-level accuracy may give too little attention to topic sentences, relevant evidence and logical order. Consequently, readers can struggle to understand how the ideas are connected. Students may then need several rounds of revision, leaving less time for other research tasks.

These effects are not inevitable. Regular reading, short writing exercises and feedback on organisation can help students improve. Addressing both language and structure is therefore a practical way to make academic writing clearer and more efficient.

内容与任务完成7分；结构与支撑7分；语言准确与多样性7分；衔接、拼写和标点4分。
